scenarios.title: Weather
scenarios.prompt: What is the weather in London this weekend?

scenarios.title: Quotes
scenarios.prompt: Compare the two quotations in my documents for supplying 20 laptops for a school: which is better value and why?

scenarios.title: Deep analysis
scenarios.prompt: Analyse both quotations and the procurement policy, produce a short comparison table (no more than six rows) and give a recommendation in two or three sentences.

scenarios.title: Picture
scenarios.prompt: Draw an image of an autumn park: maple leaves, a bench and an umbrella. No text, no labels and no letters.

scenarios.title: Video from the image
scenarios.prompt: Make a video from the image: a light breeze is blowing.

scenarios.title: Photo
scenarios.prompt: Make a photo: a plate of apples and grapes on a wooden table by the window. No packaging, no labels. What can I cook from the food in the photo? Suggest two simple dishes.

scenarios.title: Exchange rate
scenarios.prompt: Find the current US dollar to rouble exchange rate online and calculate in roubles the cost of a batch of 40 laptops at $2270 each.

scenarios.title: Voice
scenarios.prompt: Transcribe the voice message and answer the question in it.

scenarios.title: Photo edit
scenarios.prompt: Make a photo: a plate of apples and grapes on a wooden table by the window. No packaging, no labels. Replace only the apples with pears. Keep everything else unchanged.

scenarios.title: Document analysis
scenarios.prompt: Analyse both quotations and the procurement policy: name the main risk and give one recommendation with justification. Answer in no more than five sentences plus a table of no more than six rows.

scenarios.title: Fair plan
scenarios.prompt: Draw up a five-step plan for preparing the school for the autumn fair and carry it out in order: timetable, decorations, mailing, equipment, report.

scenarios.title: Yearbook cover
scenarios.prompt: Make something beautiful for the school.

scenarios.title: Mars
scenarios.prompt: Draw a realistic photo of an astronaut walking on the surface of the Moon under a black starry sky with a small distant Earth. Then edit the resulting image so that the astronaut walks on the surface of Mars. Finally, create two short videos of the astronaut walking: one based on the first image and one based on the second.

scenarios.title: Illustration
scenarios.prompt: Draw an illustration for the school yearbook: an autumn schoolyard and maple leaves. Without people, text or any labels.

scenarios.title: Café
scenarios.prompt: Make a realistic video: an empty European street café early in the morning in summer — photorealistic, cinematic footage, not a drawing or an animation. A light breeze.

scenarios.title: Timetable
scenarios.prompt: Create a weekly timetable for Year 7 in an English secondary school: 5 school days, 6 lessons per day, no subject repeated on the same day.
